query:
SELECT hash as "hash!", kind, bytes, last_used_at
           FROM cache_entry
           WHERE hash NOT IN (SELECT r.hash FROM cache_ref r
                              JOIN render_job j ON j.id = r.job_id
                              WHERE instr(?, ',' || j.state || ',') = 0)
           ORDER BY last_used_at ASC, hash ASC
           LIMIT ?
